platform.title: FFA-X Platform
platform.description: How the trusted digital bridge for global trade is organized.

overview.question: What is FFA-X?
overview.answer: FFA-X is a trusted digital bridge for global trade. It connects organizations, teams, service capabilities, business resources, and fulfillment workflows through one coordinated workspace.

participants.question: Who is FFA-X built to connect?
participants.answer: FFA-X is designed to connect buyers, sellers, factories, logistics providers, warehouses, service organizations, and the teams responsible for completing cross-border work.

ai.question: What role does AI play in FFA-X?
ai.answer: AI is a supporting layer for understanding requirements, matching capabilities, and assisting work. Business decisions, permissions, and transactions remain controlled by the connected systems, server APIs, and authorized users.

modules.question: Which modules appear in the workbench?
modules.answer: The workbench organizes authorized functions in saved tabs and split views. Plugin Center and Notifications are currently available; other business modules appear according to organization access.

access.title: Account & Access
access.description: Identity, login, protected pages, and organization access.

login.question: How do I sign in?
login.answer: FFA-X uses its unified identity service for sign-in and account registration.

protection.question: Can I open the workbench without signing in?
protection.answer: No. Protected workbench routes require a valid authenticated session and redirect unauthenticated visitors to the ZITADEL login page.

roles.question: How are organization roles applied?
roles.answer: FFA-X reads organization and project-role claims from the authenticated identity. Server APIs must enforce the corresponding tenant and permission rules for every protected operation.

logout.question: What happens when I sign out?
logout.answer: Signing out ends the FFA-X session through the configured identity provider and returns the browser to the official signed-out route.

connections.title: Systems & APIs
connections.description: How real services, work pages, and business data are connected.

api.question: How does FFA-X connect to business systems?
api.answer: FFA-X connects business systems through service adapters and coordinates information, tasks, and workflows in one workspace.

workspace.question: Are work modules embedded as external web pages?
workspace.answer: No. Functional modules run directly in the FFA-X workbench and share its theme, controls, and window interactions.

records.question: Where do production records come from?
records.answer: Business records are synchronized from connected systems and shown in the workbench according to organization and user permissions.

transactions.question: Does FFA-X replace every transaction platform?
transactions.answer: No. Independent transaction and service platforms keep their own authority. FFA-X connects participants, capabilities, information, and workflows across those systems.

workbench.title: Workbench & Interface
workbench.description: Navigation, responsive layout, language, and appearance.

navigation.question: Where do homepage links and buttons lead?
navigation.answer: Official navigation points to real FFA-X routes such as the homepage, about page, contact page, FAQ, subscriptions, login, and protected workbench. Unconfigured external links are not presented as working services.

responsive.question: Does the interface support different screen sizes?
responsive.answer: Yes. The original responsive component structure is retained for desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts.

themes.question: Are light and dark themes available?
themes.answer: Yes. The workbench retains the source theme system, including light and dark modes and the original component interactions.

languages.question: Which interface languages are available?
languages.answer: The current interface includes Simplified Chinese and English language resources.
